Import CSV, TSV, Excel, JSON, YAML, ASAP six-column format, Cell Press STAR three-column tables. Export render JSON/YAML (lossless), CSV/Excel/ASAP, RIS/BibTeX (explicit lossy-export warnings), Markdown/HTML/Word. Profiles: generic, asap (CC 4.0 assets), star-methods (interoperability), ; programmatic license attribution introspection (krt_audit_licenses()). Redact ethics consent metadata public-audience exports deposits (author exports unredacted). Extract resources manuscripts (PDF, JATS, DOCX, text) deterministic regex engine optional LLM. Deposit Zenodo Figshare, connect eLabFTW protocols.io. Provenance: editing step recorded exportable PROV-JSON RO-Crate 1.1.
